messages:
Nia (PM): Heads-up: we're consolidating customer asks into a small spec for an "in-place" private deploy upgrade that avoids public IP churn and supports airgapped delta installs. Need a runnable acceptance checklist for the launch gate.
Diego (Eng): Two big engineering constraints: 1) binary-level diffs for worker processes; 2) deterministic state migrations for DB + embeddings. We can do a staged read-only migration for indices to avoid downtime.
Leo (Eng-Infra): Networking note: customers expect 'no change' to their external egress ranges. We'll guarantee LB VIP preservation and document limitations for pod IPs. Also propose a `--preserve-egress` flag in the installer.
Hana (Field): In the field, NetOps cares about firewall changes and route table updates. They want a single PASS/FAIL preflight and a remediation bullet list. Also ask for a one-page timeline estimate.
Ruth (SRE): Rollback needs to be deterministic. Plan: snapshot control-plane state, cache previous delta for 48hrs, and provide a `redwood rollback --to-last` that auto-reverts and runs post-rollback health checks.
Nia (PM): We should define two customer flows in docs: QuickReplace (fast, short outage) and PreserveFootprint (no public IP change, longer/safer). Add expected duration bands.
Diego (Eng): For airgap deltas let's use signed manifests and a migration runner with `--simulate`. Also add a `reverse.sql` or reverse script pointer so migrations can be rolled back.
Leo (Eng-Infra): Suggest adding a 'network-shadow' utility for partners to test IP reassignments in a lab env. It won't run on customer infra, but helps validate collision scenarios.
Hana (Field): I'll prepare a pilot runbook and collect a small SOC/NetOps contact list for trial. Also propose we include an explicit 'customer-approve' confirmation step in the CLI.
Ruth (SRE): Telemetry: emit upgrade_event (id, duration_ms, success_bool) if customer opts in. Also log preflight report for debugging with an obfuscated IP list.
Nia (PM): Prioritization: Sprint1 (MVP): delta manifest schema + CLI verify/plan, preflight PASS/FAIL, runbook stub. Sprint2: console preview, network-shadow lab util, automatic canary.
deploy-bot: Ticket created PRD-1305 "Private in-place upgrade: IP preservation + airgap deltas" (assignee: Nia).
Diego (Eng): I'll pick up manifest schema + migration runner spike. Ruth, can you draft the rollback playbook?
Ruth (SRE): Yup. I'll include health check thresholds and alert language.
Nia (PM): Great. Let's reconvene next Wed to sign off acceptance. Thanks all :thumbsup:
